wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap way 161916689 defines the complete current 43-point exterior at 1260 Grant Street. The long south frontage fixes the building axis. The enclosing school grounds have a separate map identity.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the 43-vertex school envelope, tiered roofline, Grant Street stairs and four Ionic columns. Nearer levels add paired sashes and terracotta trim.
limitations: Floor heights, stone stair levels and roof profiles are estimates. The historic rendering shows the original façade before completion. Current preservation records and native plan controls take precedence for the modern sections.

Modern wing heights, exact internal phase boundaries, north window counts and roof overcladding are approximate. The model places the northeastern and northwestern circulation projections within the mapped envelope.
The unmodified elevation serves as the grade reference. Thresholds and trim are modeled at medium fidelity, with the school crest and exterior signage simplified.
